title: #354 Living Longer
prompt: In general, people are living longer now. What are the causes and problems it may bring?

promptSegments.text: In general, people are living longer now.
What are the causes and problems it may bring?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of people living longer is the improvement in medical care, exemplified by vaccines that prevent sickness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of people living longer is the improvement in medical care, exemplified by vaccines that prevent sickness.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another effective solution is educating people about maintaining a healthy lifestyle through good food and exercise.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another effective solution is educating people about maintaining a healthy lifestyle through good food and exercise.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of increased lifespan is the improvement in medical care and general living standards, allowing people to receive better treatment and live in safer environments.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of increased lifespan is the improvement in medical care and general living standards, allowing people to receive better treatment and live in safer environments.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A key solution is promoting healthy lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a good diet and exercising regularly, which reduces the risk of chronic diseases.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A key solution is promoting healthy lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a good diet and exercising regularly, which reduces the risk of chronic diseases.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The major reason is the significant improvement in global healthcare infrastructure.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The major reason is the significant improvement in global healthcare infrastructure.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: One effective solution is promoting comprehensive lifestyle changes among the population.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: One effective solution is promoting comprehensive lifestyle changes among the population.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
